compiled_state.description:
## Summary
The outbound description differ never reaches a fixed point for any description with more than one block (heading+body, multiple paragraphs, lists). The reconciler re-emits changed['description'] to Jira on EVERY reconcile pass for such tickets — permanent, content-neutral write churn.

## Root cause (runtime-confirmed)
- Outbound send/normalize uses AdfCodec (adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py): normalize_outbound(fit_outbound(x)) inserts a BLANK LINE between ADF blocks (e.g. '## Context\n\nBody'). Its own inverse decode_inbound preserves the blank line, so decode_inbound(to_wire(fitted))==fitted (the codec law ticket 3388-96e8 relies on holds for the codec).
- The differ's InboundMapper (adapters/jira/backend.py::_JiraInbound.map_remote_to_local -> inbound_fields._map_jira_to_local_fields -> _normalize_jira_body -> normalize_rich_text -> adapters/jira/adf.py::adf_to_text) decodes ADF with SINGLE '\n' between blocks ('## Context\nBody'). adf_to_text is NOT the inverse of normalize_outbound.
- outbound_field_diff.diff_canonical_fields compares fitted (blank-line) against canonical_remote['description'] (adf_to_text, single-\n) and against baseline (also adf_to_text, single-\n) via _baseline_form_matches. For a locally-authored blank-line body, neither raw_local nor fitted equals the single-\n baseline, so the description is emitted every pass.
- Proof: decode_inbound satisfies decode(encode(x))==x = True; the differ InboundMapper (adf_to_text) satisfies it = False. Two-pass diff_canonical_fields simulation: blank-line body -> 'description' in changed every pass; single-\n body -> no churn.

## Severity
2603 of 5412 local tickets are stored in blank-line form (raw!=baseline and fitted!=baseline) => churn-eligible. Corroborated by tabled epic e594-e1d0 ('writes a scattered delta every pass ~987 versions ~= ~987 passes').

## Fix options (need a decision — sensitive reconciler-CORE)
A. Canonicalize the differ's remote/baseline description via the codec's own decode_inbound (the documented inverse) instead of adf_to_text, restoring 3388's law. Blast radius: normalize_rich_text/adf_to_text also feeds local storage + comment decode (a32a-4549, 17c3, e339) — must scope to the description compare only.
B. Route BOTH sides through the outbound port (symmetric compare) in diff_canonical_fields + reconcile_check; validated to cut reconcile-check's 1080 phantom description diffs to 3 real ones. Changes what the reconciler pushes (stops normalizing Jira block-spacing).

Both change bridge convergence semantics; epic e594-e1d0 tabled sensitive reconciler-core churn work 'by decision'. Escalated from jira-reb-3526.
compiled_state.title: Reconciler re-emits multi-block descriptions on every pass (AdfCodec.normalize_outbound blank-lines vs adf_to_text single-\n asymmetry breaks 3388's decode(encode(x))==x law)
